title: People & HR
summary: Keep employee records, company structure, time off and policies in one place.
tagline: One home for your people and how your company is organised.
intro: OnCulture keeps your employee records, company structure and everyday HR admin together, so your team spends less time chasing information and more time on people.

showcase.title: Know who's off at a glance
showcase.description: A shared calendar of approved leave and public holidays, so teams can plan around absences without chasing anyone.
showcase.alt: OnCulture Who's Off calendar showing employees on leave and public holidays

title: Performance
summary: Run review cycles, set goals and connect day-to-day work to results.
tagline: Clear goals, fair reviews and work that adds up.
intro: Give every employee clear goals and regular, structured feedback. OnCulture runs your review cycles and links everyday work to the goals it moves forward.

showcase.title: See your whole team on a 9-box matrix
showcase.description: Plot every employee by performance and company values after each review cycle. Spot your stars, find the people who need support and plan growth with real data.
showcase.alt: OnCulture 9-box performance matrix grouping employees from Emerging Talent to Star

showcase.title: Goals everyone can follow
showcase.description: Give each goal owners, a timeline and clear milestones. Progress updates as milestones are completed, so everyone can see how work is moving.
showcase.alt: OnCulture goal details showing owners, timeline, progress and milestones

title: Engagement & Recognition
summary: Keep teams connected, recognise great work and hear what your people think.
tagline: Keep teams connected and recognise the behaviours you want to see.
intro: Culture is built in small, regular moments. OnCulture gives your teams simple rituals for staying aligned, celebrating each other and speaking up.

showcase.title: Know how every team is really doing
showcase.description: Team Sum Up collects regular updates on what people worked on, what's next and what's in their way, alongside an overall mood check for the team.
showcase.alt: OnCulture Team Sum Up dashboard showing responses, blockers, overall mood and recent sum ups

showcase.title: Updates linked to the goals they move
showcase.description: Each sum up shows past work, plans and blockers in one place, and can link to a goal so progress is visible without extra reporting.
showcase.alt: A single Team Sum Up showing completed work, next steps, a blocker and a linked goal

showcase.title: Recognition tied to your values
showcase.description: See who is being recognised, who gives the most appreciation and which company values show up most across the team.
showcase.alt: OnCulture Shout Out summary with top recognised members, appreciation gurus and company values

showcase.title: Give a Shout Out in seconds
showcase.description: Thank one or more colleagues, add a personal note and pick the values they showed. Send it with your name or anonymously.
showcase.alt: Give a Shout Out form with recipients, personal note, company values and an anonymous option

title: Learning
summary: A wide catalogue of culture courses, with progress tracking and certificates.
tagline: Courses that build healthier, more productive workplaces.
intro: Develop your people with a wide catalogue of culture courses on leadership, teamwork, communication and workplace safety. Short courses fit into one sitting, and full courses come with modules and quizzes.

showcase.title: Courses your team will actually finish
showcase.description: Short video lessons sit alongside readings in clear modules, so people always know where they are and what comes next.
showcase.alt: OnCulture course player showing a module video with the course outline and progress alongside

showcase.title: Quizzes that check understanding
showcase.description: Each module ends with a short quiz, so learning sticks and you can see that people understood the material, not just opened it.
showcase.alt: OnCulture course quiz question with multiple-choice answers and the course outline alongside
